_doc: Which serial number is which inverter, per plant — as the manufacturer portal names them. This file is the pinned truth for the monitoring `inverter` table: drift_check compares the table to it every morning and scripts/inverter_registry.py --apply makes the table match. When a vendor renames or replaces an inverter, change THIS file (verified against the portal), then apply. `vendor_label` is what the portal shows verbatim; `label` is our normalised name; `active: false` rows are known to monitoring but not polled.
verified_how: Growatt server.growatt.com Parameter Comparison tree, FusionSolar Device Management, SolarEdge /equipment/{site}/list (API, live) — screenshots by Tomasz 2026-09-07
